mentions.note: carried our colours prominently in the Ashcombe walk; did well in the Inter-County Walk
new member; already much success in the walking world
led in return fixture v. Metropolitan Police at Imber Court, 1 Dec
first Belgrave Harrier not gaining another award; 4th walking as an individual
disqualified in the London Transport S. & A.A Open Walk, his first time as a team man; walked as a member of Cadogan A.C. in the Middlesex Championship
second in the 10 miles walking championship
named as a shorter distance man
disqualified in the Two Miles Walk
